finalText:
Build clean now, 0 errors.

Two real bugs, both bump-shape mismatches:
- `src/core/options.js` — code still read `options.retries`, bundler now sends `retryCount`. Fixed field name.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — strict check threw on `undefined`, new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`. Now treats `undefined` as disabled, same as old default.

Rest of warnings (DEP0142 etc, unused-export, circular-import) just noise from the bump log, not errors — left alone.
